content.question: Which statement best describes the difference between bagging and boosting?
options: Bagging trains models independently on bootstrap subsets, while boosting trains them sequentially so each model corrects the errors of the previous one.
Bagging trains models sequentially, while boosting trains them independently in parallel.
Bagging is used only for regression, while boosting is used only for classification.
There is no difference - both terms describe data augmentation.
content.answer: Bagging trains models independently on bootstrap subsets, while boosting trains them sequentially so each model corrects the errors of the previous one.
